wiki.title: Jodey Arrington
wiki.extract: Jodey Cook Arrington ( AIR-ring-tən; born March 9, 1972) is an American politician serving as the U.S. representative for Texas's 19th congressional district since 2017. The district includes a large slice of West Texas, centered around Lubbock and Abilene. He is a member of the Republican Party.
